title: Kerry Kennedy remembers her mother's life and advocacy in new book
summary: Human rights advocate Kerry Kennedy talks with Amna Nawaz about her new book on her mother, Ethel Kennedy, who rose from modest beginnings to the centre of an American political family. She describes how her mother kept going after the assassination of Robert F. Kennedy, drawing on faith and activism. She also discusses her disagreements with her brother Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and her mother's habit of keeping friends across political lines.
focus: Shadow Kerry Kennedy's description of how her mother carried on after tragedy and her closing answer about respecting people you disagree with: warm, storytelling English with natural rhythm.
